title: Cổng chào Atlantis
story: Kích hoạt đại bửu thạch Orichalcum, cánh cổng dẫn vào thành phố chìm Atlantis chính thức mở ra. Hãy gặp Người canh cổng vĩ đại Thalor để vượt qua bài sát hạch và mở khóa lối vào hoàng cung.
grammarHint: Modals of Necessity & Formal Declarations (Động từ khuyết thiếu & Tuyên thệ trang trọng)

dialogueSteps.title: Grand Entrance Test
dialogueSteps.question_text: Mortal seekers! You stand before the sacred threshold of Atlantis! Do you possess the courage to enter?
dialogueSteps.text_translation: Những kẻ tìm kiếm phàm trần! Các bạn đang đứng trước ngưỡng cửa thiêng liêng của Atlantis! Các bạn có đủ dũng khí để bước vào không?

options.text: Hail Archon Thalor! We have conquered all trials and come bearing the ancient map shards!
We just want to take photos of the big gate.
Open the door quickly, we are in a hurry!

dialogueSteps.wrong_answer_message: That is incorrect. Please try again to continue the conversation

dialogueSteps.title: Oath & Gate Code Request
dialogueSteps.question_text: The gates of the sunken kingdom open only to those bound by honor. What vow do you make?
dialogueSteps.text_translation: Cánh cổng của vương quốc chìm sâu chỉ mở ra cho những ai mang danh dự. Các bạn đưa ra lời thề gì?

options.text: We swear to honor the kingdom and ask for the final mechanical codes to lift the gate!
We promise to sell all your treasures for profit.
No oaths from us, just give us the key.

dialogueSteps.wrong_answer_message: That is incorrect. Please try again to continue the conversation

dialogueSteps.question_text: Receive this sacred decree, mortal seekers. Honour every word written within it, and the gates of Atlantis shall open before you.
dialogueSteps.text_translation: Hãy nhận lấy bản chiếu thiêng liêng này, hỡi những kẻ phàm trần đi tìm chân lý. Tôn trọng từng chữ được ghi trong đó, và cánh cổng Atlantis sẽ mở ra trước mắt các ngươi.

cluebook.title: 📜 ARCHON THALOR'S SACRED DECREE
cluebook.content: First, at the Three Great Gemstone Pedestals, set the Sun Pearl in its place: Insert the Sun Pearl into the top slot. Next, complete the philosopher's line carved into the Gate Arch: Wisdom and courage open every door. Then join your strength at the Stone Rotation Axis and push: Push the stone pillar with all strength! Finally, on the Royal Oath Pedestal, close Chapter One with the vow—We swear to protect the secrets of Atlantis.

questions.question_text: The Orichalcum pedestal is waiting for the command to mount the first Great Gemstone!
questions.text_translation: Hô: Insert the Sun Pearl into the top slot.
questions.hint: Thalor's secret: Insert the Sun Pearl into the top slot.

options.text: Insert the Sun Pearl into the top slot now!
Drop the jewel on the floor and run!
Keep the jewel inside your backpack!

questions.question_text: Type the command for mounting the Sun Pearl!
questions.text_translation: Gõ khẩu lệnh lắp ngọc trai mặt trời vào bệ.
questions.hint: Thalor's secret: Insert the Sun Pearl into the top slot.
options: insert the sun pearl into the top slot

questions.question_text: The ancient inscription is missing a clause. Complete the saying that opens the gate!
questions.text_translation: Gõ: Wisdom and courage open every door
questions.hint: Thalor's secret: Wisdom and courage open every door.

options.text: Wisdom and courage open every door
Fear and greed will conquer all
Gold and silver are all we need

questions.question_text: Type the complete saying carved on the gate arch!
questions.text_translation: Gõ trọn vẹn câu danh ngôn khắc trên vòm cổng.
questions.hint: Thalor's secret: Wisdom and courage open every door.
options: wisdom and courage open every door

questions.question_text: The ancient stone winch is far too heavy. We need a command for all four to push at once!
questions.text_translation: Hô: Push the stone pillar with all strength!
questions.hint: Thalor's secret: Push the stone pillar with all strength!

options.text: Push the stone pillar with all strength, heave!
Pull the rope in the opposite direction!
Let go of the handles immediately!

questions.question_text: Type the order that makes all four push at once!
questions.text_translation: Gõ khẩu lệnh để bốn người cùng đẩy một lúc.
questions.hint: Thalor's secret: Push the stone pillar with all strength!
options: push the stone pillar with all strength

questions.question_text: Thalor watches the winch: which word tells everyone to push at the very same moment?
questions.text_translation: Từ nào ra hiệu cho mọi người cùng đẩy một lúc?
questions.hint: Sailors shout 'Heave!' when they push or pull together.

options.text: Heave!
Later!
Alone!

questions.question_text: Archon Thalor: proclaim the oath aloud before all the ancestors of Atlantis!
questions.text_translation: Tuyên thệ: We swear to protect the secrets of Atlantis.
questions.hint: Thalor's secret: We swear to protect the secrets of Atlantis.

options.text: We swear to protect the secrets of Atlantis forever!
We swear nothing and will tell everyone about this place!
Goodbye, we are leaving without entering!

questions.question_text: Type the royal oath in full!
questions.text_translation: Gõ trọn vẹn lời tuyên thệ hoàng gia.
questions.hint: Thalor's secret: We swear to protect the secrets of Atlantis.
options: we swear to protect the secrets of atlantis

questions.question_text: The ancestors ask for one word: type the English word for a solemn promise.
questions.text_translation: Gõ từ tiếng Anh chỉ một lời thề trang nghiêm.
questions.hint: You have just made an 'oath' before the ancestors.
